claims.claim: Irregular expenses occur less frequently than the budget period. Annual insurance, repairs or gifts may be predictable in amount or timing even when they do not recur monthly. A sinking-fund allocation spreads an expected cost across periods; an emergency buffer addresses uncertainty. Do not count the same saving transfer and later spending twice when consolidating accounts. Distinguish planned allocations from actual expenses and reconcile monthly.

locators.limitations: Estimates may differ from actual costs
